mechanisms.label: ERROR

mechanisms.label: CORRECT
mechanisms.transformation: none; explicit non-contiguous domain is outside the frozen text grammar
mechanisms.eligibility: formal solver supports the semantics but text parser must return UNSUPPORTED

mechanisms.label: UNRESOLVED
mechanisms.eligibility: at least two readings are defensible and parser must return UNSUPPORTED

rule: No row enters the primary challenge unless its predeclared label and expected parser boundary are verified without consulting AXIOM-X decisions. ERROR rows require a solver-proven symmetric difference. UNRESOLVED rows are excluded from correctness denominators.
